spans.s:
उक्थं [वच्-थक्]
1 A saying,
sentence, verse, hymn (स्तोत्रं).
--2
Eulogy, praise.
--3 N. of the
Sāmaveda (Trik.); a variety of
Sāma; (सामभेदः सामविशेषः).
--4 (In
ritual) A kind of recitation or certain
recited verses (opp. सामन् chanted,
and यजुस् muttered verses).
--5 The
उक्थ sacrifice.
--क्था N. of a metre,
see Appendix
--Comp.
--पत्रः
{1} a sacrifice (having verses as
its vehicle or leaves). {2} a
sacrificer (यजमान).
--पात्रं {1} a sacrificer.
{2} vessels or libations offered
during the recitation of an उक्थ.
--भृत्
m. a sage who offers or divides
Ukthas.
--वर्द्धन a. to be magnified or
celebrated in praise, an epithet of
Indra.
--वाहस् a. offering verses; or
one to whom verses are offered.
--शंसिन् a. praising, uttering the Ukthas.
(--m.) a kind of priest.
--शस्, --शास्,
शस a. Ved. uttering a verse,
praising.
--शुष्म a. whose strength is
praise. {2} loudly resonant with
verses. (--क्था) -वी a. fond of or reciting
verses.

उक्थिन् a. [उक्थ-इनि]
1 Uttering
verses, praising.
--2 Accompanied by
praise or Ukthas. --m. Indra and
others.

उक्थ्य a. [उक्थमर्हति यत्]
1
Accompanied by praise.
--2 Deserving
praise or verses.
--क्थ्यः
1 A
libation at the morning and midday
sacrifices.
--2 N. of a sacrifice
formng part of the ज्योतिष्टोम sacrifice.
--3 A Soma sacrifice.
